item.title: Spanish court declines to fine NordVPN over LaLiga piracy blocking order
item.description:
📝 Fines Rejected According to NordVPN, the court declined this request. The technical evidence that NordVPN presented in court relied on two points. This means that the main proceedings are still ahead.
🔗 Read more: https://torrentfreak.com/spanish-court-declines-to-fine-nordvpn-over-laliga-piracy-blocking-order/
